description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'ParamRule' class, which appears to be used for validating parameters by associating a parameter key with a set of validation rules and related metadata within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: ParamRule
classes.description: Represents validation rules for a specific parameter key, including rules, default value, and validation strategy.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes ParamRule with a parameter key and one or more rules.

methods.name: getParamKey
methods.description: Returns the parameter key associated with this rule.

methods.name: setParamKey
methods.description: Sets the parameter key for this rule.

methods.name: getRules
methods.description: Retrieves the array of rules associated with this parameter.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Sets the array of rules for this parameter.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Returns the default value for the parameter if not provided.

methods.name: setDefault
methods.description: Sets the default value for the parameter.

methods.name: getCompositeClass
methods.description: Gets the validation composition class used to combine rules.

methods.name: setCompositeClass
methods.description: Sets the validation composition class; throws exception if invalid.
